QuestInfo.name: The Smell Below
QuestInfo.0: #b#p502##k in #m10004000# looks troubled. Maybe I should talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p502##k said the mushrooms in the Ant Tunnel have the same dark smell as the Balrog he fought long ago. He asked me to defeat #r30 #o19#s#k and #r30 #o21#s#k, then come back and tell him what I saw.
QuestInfo.2: I defeated the mushrooms in the Ant Tunnel. #b#p502##k said the dark power under Victoria Island is waking up again, and that I should keep getting stronger.

0.0: Hmph. You again. Tell me, have you been to the Ant Tunnel under #m10005000#?
0.1: Long ago, I fought the Balrog deep in that tunnel. I still remember its smell. Lately, the mushrooms down there carry that same smell.
0.2: The #r#o21#s#k are the worst, and even the #r#o19#s#k are getting wild. Go down there and defeat #r30 #o19#s#k and #r30 #o21#s#k. Then come back and tell me what you saw.

yes.0: Good. The Ant Tunnel starts in #m10005000#. Don't be careless. Those mushrooms don't feel pain.

no.0: Afraid of mushrooms? Come back when you've found your courage.

1.0: You're back. Yes... I can smell it on you. That dark power is waking up again.
1.1: I won't go back down there. That fight cost me too much. But you might be strong enough one day. Take this, and keep training.

mob.0: You haven't defeated enough of them yet. #r30 #o19#s#k and #r30 #o21#s#k. Don't come back until it's done.
